title: Synthesis and application of a deep eutectic solvent as a green catalyst for use in oil esterification: DOE optimization and method greenness analysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,48628-48638
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06461A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sassi Siddiqui, Mahabash Khanzada, Saima Qayoom Memon, Amber Rehana Solangi, Muhammad Yar Khuhawar
A green deep eutectic solvent based on tetrabutylammonium bromide and oxalic acid is used for the conversion of free fatty acids in used oil into useful esters. This method demonstrates superior greenness over conventional acid catalysts.
